relations.text: FICOスコアの販売を担う認可済みの販売パートナーである
relations.text_en: Experian is a licensed distribution partner for FICO Scores

source.label: Fair Isaac 10-K(2025年9月期)
source.quote: These Scores are distributed directly by us through our myFICO.com subscription offering and indirectly through our licensed distribution partners, including Experian and certain lenders through the FICO ® Score Open Access Program.

relations.text: 3大信用情報機関の一社として、FICOと競合するスコア商品の合弁に加わっている
relations.text_en: Experian is one of three bureaus in a joint venture selling a credit scoring product competitive with FICO's

source.label: Fair Isaac 10-K(2025年9月期)
source.quote: For example, Experian, TransUnion and Equifax have formed a joint venture that is selling a credit scoring product competitive with our products.

relations.text: エクスペリアン、トランスユニオン、エキファックスとの契約が、2025年度の売上の51%を占めた
relations.text_en: Agreements with Experian, TransUnion and Equifax together made up 51% of FICO's fiscal 2025 revenues

source.label: Fair Isaac 10-K(2025年9月期)
source.quote: During fiscal 2025, 2024 and 2023, revenues generated from our agreements with Experian, TransUnion and Equifax collectively accounted for 51%, 45% and 41% of our total revenues, respectively.

relations.text: FICO Score XDの販売パートナーとして、レキシスネクシス・リスク・ソリューションズと並んで名が挙がる
relations.text_en: Equifax is named with LexisNexis Risk Solutions as a distribution partner for FICO Score XD

source.label: Fair Isaac 10-K(2025年9月期)
source.quote: FICO Score XD is available to lenders through our distribution partners, LexisNexis Risk Solutions and Equifax.

relations.text: 顧客獲得向け市場で、FICOの競合先として名が挙がる
relations.text_en: Equifax is named as a competitor in the customer origination market

source.label: Fair Isaac 10-K(2025年9月期)
source.quote: In the customer origination market, we compete with Experian, Equifax, Moody’s, Meridian Link, and CGI, among others.

companies.name: レキシスネクシス・リスク・ソリューションズ

source.label: Fair Isaac 10-K(2025年9月期)
source.quote: FICO Score XD is available to lenders through our distribution partners, LexisNexis Risk Solutions and Equifax.

relations.text: 不正対策、マーケティング、意思決定基盤の各市場で競合する
relations.text_en: Pegasystems is named as a competitor in the decision platform market

source.label: Fair Isaac 10-K(2025年9月期)
source.quote: In the decision platform market, we compete with Pegasystems, IBM and SAS, among others.

source.label: Fair Isaac 10-K(2025年9月期)
source.quote: In the customer management market, we compete with Experian and SAS, among others.
